user.title: Pair with Sunplug
user.description: Enter the 6-character pairing code shown in the Sunplug app.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to Sunplug
reauth_confirm.description: Your Sunplug pairing has expired. Enter a new pairing code from the Sunplug app.

error.invalid_code: That pairing code was not accepted. Check the code and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Sunplug. Check your internet connection and try again.

abort.no_power_sensors: Set up your Home Assistant Energy dashboard first, with at least one solar production power sensor and one grid power sensor. Go to {energy_url} to configure it.
abort.already_configured: This Home Assistant instance is already connected to Sunplug.

slow_entity.title: Sunplug is receiving slow updates from {entity_id}
slow_entity.description: The {entity_id} sensor from the {integration} integration is updating slower than every 5 minutes. Sunplug readings for your home will be delayed accordingly. If this sensor comes from a cloud-polling integration, a local alternative may update faster.

slow_entity_with_alternative.title: Sunplug is receiving slow updates from {entity_id}
slow_entity_with_alternative.description: The {entity_id} sensor from the {integration} integration is updating slower than every 5 minutes. Sunplug readings for your home will be delayed accordingly. Consider switching to {alternative}, which can update locally and faster.
